tests.label: simulator invariants
tests.command: node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import {simulate,environmentFactors} from './dist/model.js'; for(const age of [18,40,65,80])for(const sex of ['male','female'])for(const scenario of ['baseline','improve','pressure']){const rows=simulate({age,sex,scenario}); assert.equal(rows.length,31); for(let i=0;i<rows.length;i++){const r=rows[i];assert(Math.abs(r.total+r.survival-1)<1e-10);assert(Math.abs(r.cumulative.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)-r.total)<1e-10);assert(r.total>=0&&r.total<=1);if(i)assert(r.total>=rows[i-1].total);}}assert.deepEqual(environmentFactors(),[1,1,1,1,1,1]);console.log('48 scenario runs passed conservation and monotonicity checks');"
summary_lines: 48 scenario runs passed conservation and monotonicity checks

export_scope_scan.limits: Pattern/file inventory review is not exhaustive secret detection or production security certification.
